cards.ex: My grandparents are enjoying their golden years traveling the world.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim va bobom oltin davrlarida dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishdan zavqlanishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qarilik davri, odatda pensiyada o'tkaziladigan vaqt.

cards.ex: After the kids moved out, they decided to downsize to a smaller apartment.
cards.exUz: Bolalar ketganidan keyin, ular kichikroq kvartiraga ko'chishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq uydan kichikroq uyga ko'chmoq.

cards.ex: Now that I'm retired, I can finally put my feet up and relax.
cards.exUz: Endi nafaqaga chiqqanimdan keyin, nihoyat dam olib, hordiq chiqarishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish, hech narsa qilmasdan hordiq chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: She hopes to age gracefully and stay active as long as possible.
cards.exUz: U go'zal qarib, imkon qadar faol bo'lib qolishga umid qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va baxtli holda qarilikni o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: They've been saving their nest egg for retirement.
cards.exUz: Ular nafaqa uchun jamg'armalarini tejashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak uchun yig'ilgan pul, ayniqsa nafaqa uchun.

cards.ex: The senior citizen discount applies to anyone over 65.
cards.exUz: Keksalar uchun chegirma 65 yoshdan oshganlarga tegishli.
cards.uzDef: Katta yoshdagi odam, odatda 65 yoshdan katta.

cards.ex: It's important to start a retirement plan early in your career.
cards.exUz: Karyerangizning boshida nafaqa rejasini boshlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Nafaqaga chiqqandan keyin moliyaviy ta'minlash rejasi.

cards.ex: He's been drawing a pension since he retired five years ago.
cards.exUz: U besh yil oldin nafaqaga chiqqanidan beri nafaqa olmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nafaqaga chiqqanidan keyin pul olmoq.

cards.ex: Her grandmother is in a nursing home where she receives 24-hour care.
cards.exUz: Uning buvisi qariyalar uyida 24 soatlik parvarish oladi.
cards.uzDef: Qariyalar uchun tibbiy yordam ko'rsatadigan joy.

cards.ex: He's starting to get a few grey hairs.
cards.exUz: Uning sochlarida bir nechta oq tolalar paydo bo'la boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Sochlarning rangi oqarganligi, qarilik belgisi.

cards.ex: My grandpa is a real silver surfer; he spends hours online.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom haqiqiy internetdagi qariya; u internetda soatlab vaqt o'tkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta yoshli odamlar internetdan foydalanuvchilar

cards.ex: He's not over the hill just yet; he's still got a lot of energy.
cards.exUz: U hali qarib ketgani yo'q; uning hali ham ko'p energiyasi bor.
cards.uzDef: O'zining eng yaxshi davrini o'tkazib bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Now that you're retired, just take it easy and enjoy life.
cards.exUz: Endi nafaqaga chiqqaningizdan keyin, o'zingizni asrang va hayotdan zavqlaning.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni asrang, zo'riqmang, dam oling.

cards.ex: She's worried about her fading memory as she gets older.
cards.exUz: U yoshi ulg'aygan sari xotirasining susayishidan xavotirda.
cards.uzDef: Xotiraning yomonlashuvi, esdan chiqarish.

cards.ex: He spent his twilight years surrounded by his family.
cards.exUz: U qarilik davrini oilasi qurshovida o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotning oxirgi yillari, qarilik davri.

cards.ex: They're determined to live life to the fullest in retirement.
cards.exUz: Ular nafaqada hayotdan maksimal darajada zavqlanishga qaror qilishgan.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdan maksimal darajada zavqlanmoq.

cards.ex: They're adjusting to the empty nest now that their youngest has gone to college.
cards.exUz: Ular eng kichik farzandlari kollejga ketganidan keyin bo'sh uyga moslashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bolalar uyidan ketganidan keyin qolgan bo'sh uy.

cards.ex: Retirement gave him a new lease on life; he started volunteering.
cards.exUz: Nafaqaga chiqishi unga yangi hayot berdi; u ko'ngilli bo'lib ishlay boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi imkoniyat, yangi kuch paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: Sometimes I wish he would act his age instead of trying to be young.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan uning yosh ko'rinishga urinish o'rniga yoshiga mos ravishda harakat qilishini xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Yoshingizga mos ravishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's past his prime as an athlete, but he's still a great coach.
cards.exUz: U sportchi sifatida eng yaxshi vaqtini o'tkazib bo'ldi, lekin u hali ham ajoyib murabbiy.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi davringiz o'tib ketganini aytish.

cards.ex: As you get on in years, it's important to stay active.
cards.exUz: Yillar o'tishi bilan faol bo'lib qolish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qarimoq, yillar o'tishi bilan yoshi ulg'aymoq.

cards.ex: I had a senior moment and forgot where I parked the car.
cards.exUz: Menda qarilik lahzasi yuz berdi va mashinani qayerga qo'yganimni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Kichik esdan chiqarish, qariyalik bilan bog'liq.

cards.ex: He's a bit long in the tooth to be starting a new career.
cards.exUz: U yangi ish boshlash uchun biroz qarib qolgan.
cards.uzDef: Katta yoshdagi, qarib qolgan.

cards.ex: They decided to live out their days in a quiet village.
cards.exUz: Ular hayotlarini tinch qishloqda o'tkazishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotning oxirini (qolgan kunlarini) o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: My grandfather is in his second childhood, always playing pranks.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom ikkinchi bolaligida, doimo hazil qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qarilikda bolalarcha harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She took early retirement to spend more time with her family.
cards.exUz: U oilasi bilan ko'proq vaqt o'tkazish uchun erta nafaqaga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan muddatdan oldin nafaqaga chiqish.

cards.ex: It's important to stay active in retirement to keep your mind sharp.
cards.exUz: Nafaqada aqliy salohiyatni saqlab qolish uchun faol bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy va ruhiy jihatdan faol bo'lish.

cards.ex: Growing older can be challenging, but it also brings new opportunities.
cards.exUz: Qarib borish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin, lekin u yangi imkoniyatlarni ham olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Yoshning o'tishi, qarilikka yaqinlashish.

cards.ex: He received a generous golden handshake when he left the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyadan ketayotganda saxiy miqdorda pul oldi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan ketayotganda beriladigan katta pul miqdori.

cards.ex: Many people travel extensively in later life.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar qariganlarida ko'p sayohat qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotning oxirgi qismi, qarilik.
